Version Control

โทเค็นการเข้าถึง

A secure, revocable credential generated by systems (e.g., GitHub, GitLab) to authenticate users or services for repository access and API integration.

Definition

A secure, revocable credential generated by systems (e.g., GitHub, GitLab) to authenticate users or services for repository access and API integration.

Operational example

Personal access tokens replace passwords for automated repository operations, providing granular permission control and enhanced security.
